parameters.content:
## Lokalise targets audit - nightly

Weekdays 19:00 Europe/Madrid. **One product per run** (since 2026-10-07): picks the next product in the rotation and audits ALL its due active Lokalise projects together (FE + BE + emails...), one INTERNAT Task, one review sheet (tab per language, Project column), one #i18n-team post. QRcreate / My QR Code count as separate products. Active list = lokalise_project_labels minus EXCLUDE (My QR Code html, Chatbot - out of the rotation since 2026-10-07).

Checks (worker ME3cLqQy0Dlzm6si): glossary, style-guide rules, accuracy, mechanics, register, typography, case, doubled words, pt-BR vocabulary, Korean -니까?, same-source consistency. No quotes/exclamation/spelling/full-stop checks.

**Force a product**: FORCE_PRODUCT in Pick today's project. **Rotation state** in targets_audit_rotation (one row per project) — delete a product's rows to re-audit it sooner.
